NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: APK Junk Cleanup
patches.description: Removes build artifacts and metadata that bloat the APK: Play Services / Firebase version files, protobuf descriptors, debug probes, kotlin builtins, META-INF subfolder clutter, and misc junk. Safe — only removes files with no runtime purpose.

options.title: Keep Only One Architecture
options.description: Keep native libraries (.so files) for only one CPU architecture. To generate separate APKs for each architecture, run this patch multiple times with a different architecture selected each time.

options.title: Target architecture
options.description: Which architecture to keep when splitting is enabled.

patches.name: Add Toast
patches.description: Shows a custom toast message when the app starts. Works on any app.

options.title: Show once
options.description: On: the toast only shows on the first launch. Off: it shows on every launch.

patches.name: Clean main UI
patches.description: Hides the bottom navigation bar, the top-right guide icon, and the Rate/Help/About drawer items, and brings the connect/create/join buttons to front. Reapplied on create, resume, and drawer open (and retried for ~1.8s after each) since some of these views are inflated lazily.

patches.name: Custom DPI (Universal)
patches.description: Change this app's display size without touching your phone's system settings. Make it bigger if things look too small, or smaller to fit more on screen. Works on any app.

options.title: Display scale
options.description: Scales this app's display relative to the device's own setting. 100% = no change, 150% = 1.5x larger, 50% = half size. Range 25-300%.

patches.name: Disable Notification Defaults
patches.description: Turns off the Toolbar, Recommended contents, and Tool notifications channels by default.

patches.name: Disable ad dialog when reopening app
patches.description: Prevents the full-screen "loading ad" dialog from appearing when the app is reopened after being minimized.

patches.name: ES File Explorer Ui Cleanup
patches.description: Removes BookMark, New Files, Cleaner Row In HomePage, Cleans More menu actions

patches.name: Hide File Transfer, Video Playlist, Private Folder tiles
patches.description: Removes the File Transfer, Video Playlist, and Private Folder tiles from the tools tile list.

patches.name: Hide Me tab promo items
patches.description: Collapses the WhatsApp, Legal, and Help entries on the Me tab.

patches.name: Hide Settings Items
patches.description: Hides the Download tools and Phone clean categories, and their sub-items, from Settings.

patches.name: Hide local tiles banner
patches.description: Collapses the local device tiles banner.

patches.name: Hide more actions
patches.description: Hides Hide, Add to desktop, Encrypt, Decrypt, Add bookmark, Web Search, Copy to, Move to, Transfer, and Playing from the "More actions" menu.

patches.name: Hide network, tools and bookmarks on home page
patches.description: Hides the Network, Tools and Bookmarks sections from the home page section list.

patches.name: Png Optimizer
patches.description: Compresses PNG images without losing quality and strips hidden metadata (DPI, timestamps, text) to make the app smaller. Only rewrites files when the result is actually smaller.

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Stubs known ad SDK entry points and poisons ad-network URL strings across the whole app.

patches.name: Remove Analytics
patches.description: Disables tracking and crash-reporting tools, corrupts analytics web links inside the code, and removes background tracking services.

patches.name: Remove Debug Info
patches.description: Removes debug information (line numbers, variable names, source file references) from every class in the .dex files to reduce overall APK size.

patches.name: Remove Duplicate Graphics
patches.description: Keeps images for only one screen density (like xhdpi) and removes copies for all other densities. Android will automatically scale the kept images, making the app significantly smaller.

options.title: Target density
options.description: Density bucket to keep; duplicates are stripped from every other bucket.

patches.name: Remove Languages
patches.description: Removes translations for languages you don't use across ALL resource types (strings, drawables, layouts, raw, xml, etc.). Only keeps the languages you pick. Base resources with no language code are always preserved.

options.title: Languages to keep
options.description: Language codes (e.g. en, ru, es) to preserve. All other language variants are deleted.

patches.name: Remove Watch Ad To Download
patches.description: Removes the requirement to watch a rewarded ad before a download starts.

patches.name: Skip splash and language screens
patches.description: Jumps straight to the main activity from the splash screen, skipping the splash animation, the language-selection screen, and any ad/app-open dialog normally shown first.

patches.name: Skip splash screen
patches.description: Moves the launcher intent filter to the main activity and calls the all-files-access permission request directly, instead of showing the splash activity and its full-screen 'grant storage access' dialog.

patches.name: Skip splash screen
patches.description: Jumps straight to the main activity from the splash screen, skipping the splash animation entirely. Also restores the storage-permission request and local media scan that the splash screen normally performs, so the Apps/Photo/Video tabs still load.

patches.name: Skip welcome screen
patches.description: Moves the launcher intent filters and app shortcuts from the welcome/splash activity to the main activity, so the app boots straight past the splash and update screen.

patches.name: Speed up splash screen
patches.description: Enters the main activity directly after the splash permission check instead of delaying for the additional external-storage check.
